note: Final model trained on timesteps 1-29 only (train_proper_mask), NOT refit on the full 1-34 train_mask, to preserve score-distribution consistency between the validation-tuned threshold and the model it is applied to. An earlier version of this script retrained a second model on the full train_mask before evaluating, which caused a val->test F1 collapse (0.7955 -> 0.4058) because the threshold was tuned on one model's score distribution and applied to a different, freshly-retrained model's distribution.
